entries.en: She glanced meaningfully at the clock, and we began gathering our things.
entries.zh: 她意味深长地看了一眼钟，我们便开始收拾东西。

entries.en: We did everything humanly possible to finish the repairs before winter.
entries.zh: 我们尽了人力所能，在冬季到来前完成维修。

entries.en: The laboratory tested soil samples for dioxin after the industrial fire.
entries.zh: 工业火灾过后，实验室检测了土壤样本中的二噁英。

entries.en: She scrunched the empty paper bag into a ball and recycled it.
entries.zh: 她把空纸袋揉成一团，放去回收。

entries.en: The screen changed almost instantaneously when he pressed the green button.
entries.zh: 他按下绿色按钮后，屏幕几乎立即就发生了变化。

entries.meaningZh: 与所描绘时代不符的事物
entries.en: The wristwatch was an obvious anachronism in a film set in medieval France.
entries.zh: 在一部以中世纪法国为背景的电影里，那块腕表明显不合时代。

entries.en: The lessor met the new tenant at the flat to hand over the keys.
entries.zh: 出租人在公寓与新租客见面，交付钥匙。

entries.en: In the story, an android works alongside the crew on a distant planet.
entries.zh: 在这个故事里，一个人形机器人与船员们一起在遥远的星球工作。

entries.en: The collector placed an old Iraqi dinar beside the other banknotes.
entries.zh: 收藏者把一张旧伊拉克第纳尔纸币放在其他纸币旁边。

entries.en: In pragmatics, students examine how context changes the interpretation of an utterance.
entries.zh: 在语用学中，学生们研究语境如何改变对话语的理解。

entries.en: The chemistry teacher marked barium on the periodic table during the lesson.
entries.zh: 化学老师在课堂上指出了元素周期表中的钡。

entries.en: The technician replaced a damaged resistor on the small circuit board.
entries.zh: 技术员更换了那块小电路板上损坏的电阻器。

entries.en: The abandoned factory's smokestack was visible from every street in the village.
entries.zh: 从村里的每条街道都能看见那座废弃工厂的烟囱。

entries.en: The rough ferry crossing made him feel as though he might puke.
entries.zh: 渡船航行时颠簸得厉害，让他觉得自己快要吐了。

entries.en: The café listed its daily specials on a chalkboard beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆把每日特色菜写在入口旁的一块黑板上。

entries.en: A curious llama stretched its neck over the fence to watch us.
entries.zh: 一只好奇的美洲驼把脖子伸过围栏看着我们。

entries.en: The family photographs were irreplaceable, so she stored copies in another house.
entries.zh: 那些家庭照片无法替代，所以她在另一处房子里保存了副本。

entries.en: The anatomy model has a removable mandible so students can examine the joint.
entries.zh: 这具解剖模型的下颌骨可以拆卸，方便学生观察关节。

entries.en: She poured the sauce through a strainer to remove the remaining seeds.
entries.zh: 她把酱汁倒过筛网，滤掉剩下的籽。

entries.en: The seamstress shortened the sleeves without changing the shape of the jacket.
entries.zh: 女裁缝缩短了袖子，却没有改变夹克的版型。

entries.en: The diagram uses blue arrows to show venous blood returning to the heart.
entries.zh: 这幅示意图用蓝色箭头表示静脉血回流至心脏。

entries.en: I goofed and put the wrong date on every invitation.
entries.zh: 我犯了个错，把每张请柬上的日期都写错了。

entries.en: The maintenance team reduced downtime by replacing the worn parts before they failed.
entries.zh: 维修团队在磨损零件发生故障前就更换了它们，从而减少了停机时间。

entries.en: Her prescient warning about the bridge seemed remarkable after the flood.
entries.zh: 洪水过后，她先前对那座桥发出的警告显得很有先见之明。

entries.en: The laboratory report listed albumin among the proteins measured in the sample.
entries.zh: 实验室报告将白蛋白列为样本中接受测量的蛋白质之一。

entries.en: He tried to unscrew the jar lid with a dry cloth.
entries.zh: 他试着用一块干布拧开罐子盖。

entries.en: The biography describes her early years as a naturalized citizen in a new country.
entries.zh: 这部传记描写了她归化入籍后在新国家生活的早期岁月。

entries.en: Water entered my snorkel when a wave broke over my head.
entries.zh: 一个浪头打过我的头顶时，水灌进了我的潜泳呼吸管。

entries.en: A veteran newsman interviewed the mayor outside the newly opened station.
entries.zh: 一位资深新闻记者在新启用的车站外采访了市长。

entries.en: He missed the excitement and craziness of travelling with the band.
entries.zh: 他怀念跟随乐队巡演时的兴奋与疯狂。

entries.en: The greenhouse has separate sections for transgenic plants and their unmodified counterparts.
entries.zh: 温室为转基因植物和相应的未改造植物划分了不同区域。

entries.en: The damaged file contained unrecognizable characters where the headings should have been.
entries.zh: 损坏的文件在本该出现标题的位置显示了无法识别的字符。

entries.en: The museum displayed old bottles once sold as homoeopathic remedies.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一些旧药瓶，它们过去以顺势疗法药剂的名义销售。

entries.en: A narrow path through the cemetery led to the family's stone mausoleum.
entries.zh: 墓园里的一条小路通向这个家族的石砌陵墓。

entries.en: The compositor arranged the metal letters before the printer prepared the press.
entries.zh: 排字工人先排好金属活字，随后印刷工准备印刷机。

entries.en: The tournament expelled a cheater who had secretly altered the equipment.
entries.zh: 比赛将一名暗中改动器材的作弊者除名了。

entries.en: An aftershock rattled the windows while the neighbours waited outside.
entries.zh: 邻居们在室外等候时，一次余震震得窗户发响。

entries.en: The team felt euphoric after winning its first match of the season.
entries.zh: 赢得本赛季首场比赛后，整个队伍都兴奋极了。

entries.en: An unopened letter from her brother lay beside the breakfast plate.
entries.zh: 哥哥寄来的一封未拆的信放在早餐盘旁。

entries.en: We packed reusable cups so there would be less rubbish after the picnic.
entries.zh: 我们带了可重复使用的杯子，这样野餐后就能少留些垃圾。

entries.en: A small animal rustled through the underbrush before disappearing behind a tree.
entries.zh: 一只小动物窸窸窣窣地穿过林下灌丛，随后消失在树后。

entries.en: The mayor called the proposal fiscally responsible because it used existing buildings.
entries.zh: 市长认为这项提案利用现有建筑，在财政上是负责任的。

entries.en: The brochure uses a fashionable buzzword in almost every paragraph.
entries.zh: 这本宣传册几乎每一段都使用了一个时髦的流行词。

entries.en: The memoir describes years of political indoctrination at the military school.
entries.zh: 这部回忆录描述了军校里多年的政治思想灌输。

entries.en: The documentary includes a reporter's account of a brief firefight near the border.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片收录了一位记者对边境附近一次短暂交火的叙述。

entries.en: The baker explained how kneading helps develop the gluten in the dough.
entries.zh: 面包师解释了揉面如何帮助面团中的面筋形成结构。

entries.en: The manager asked the customer to stop making lewd remarks to the staff.
entries.zh: 经理要求那位顾客停止对员工说猥亵的话。

entries.en: She lifted the handset and heard a familiar voice on the line.
entries.zh: 她拿起电话听筒，听到了一个熟悉的声音。

entries.en: The landlord remained unresponsive to repeated requests for a copy of the receipt.
entries.zh: 房东对多次索取收据副本的请求一直不作回应。

entries.en: The crew checked the navigational equipment before leaving the harbour.
entries.zh: 船员们离港前检查了导航设备。

entries.en: Her first triathlon began with a swim in the cold lake.
entries.zh: 她参加的第一场铁人三项比赛，从在冰冷的湖水中游泳开始。

entries.en: The appraiser examined the painting's frame and signature before estimating its value.
entries.zh: 估价师先检查了画框和签名，再估算这幅画的价值。

entries.en: He shaved off his goatee, and his colleagues barely recognized him.
entries.zh: 他剃掉了山羊胡，同事们差点没认出他。

entries.en: The characters endure a hellish night in the abandoned mountain hotel.
entries.zh: 故事人物在废弃的山间旅馆里熬过了一个可怕的夜晚。

entries.meaningZh: 城市郊区及其生活环境
entries.en: The film contrasts crowded city streets with the quiet lawns of suburbia.
entries.zh: 这部电影将拥挤的城市街道与郊区宁静的草坪作了对照。

entries.en: The neighbours decided to litigate after several attempts at negotiation failed.
entries.zh: 几次协商失败后，邻居们决定通过诉讼解决争端。

entries.en: He placed the record on the turntable and gently lowered the needle.
entries.zh: 他把唱片放到唱机转盘上，轻轻落下唱针。

entries.en: The children looked expectantly at the box as their father untied the ribbon.
entries.zh: 父亲解开丝带时，孩子们满怀期待地望着盒子。

entries.en: Crossing the narrow bridge looked dicey after the heavy rain.
entries.zh: 大雨过后，走过那座窄桥看起来有些危险。

entries.en: The teacher explained why heavy rain is a more natural collocation than strong rain.
entries.zh: 老师解释了为什么heavy rain比strong rain是更自然的词语搭配。

entries.en: She checked the tightness of each knot before lifting the bundle.
entries.zh: 她检查了每个结是否系紧，才提起包裹。

entries.en: The laboratory measured radiocarbon in a fragment of wood from the excavation.
entries.zh: 实验室测量了发掘所得一块木片中的放射性碳。

entries.en: The search of the abandoned warehouse formed part of a wider manhunt.
entries.zh: 搜查那座废弃仓库是一次更大范围搜捕行动的一部分。

entries.en: A witness described an attacker running amok through the station.
entries.zh: 一位目击者描述了一名袭击者在车站里疯狂行凶的情形。

entries.en: The dog settled back on its haunches and watched the gate.
entries.zh: 那只狗坐在后腿上，望着大门。

entries.en: The hens clucked softly as the farmer scattered grain across the yard.
entries.zh: 农民把谷粒撒在院子里时，母鸡们轻轻地咯咯叫着。

entries.en: The history lecture examined the rise of homoeopathy in nineteenth-century Europe.
entries.zh: 这场历史讲座研究了顺势疗法在十九世纪欧洲的兴起。

entries.en: One silver sequin had come loose from the dancer's jacket.
entries.zh: 舞者夹克上的一片银色亮片松脱了。

entries.en: She wore a sleeveless cotton top while working in the warm greenhouse.
entries.zh: 她在温暖的温室里干活时，穿了一件无袖棉质上衣。

entries.en: Their arrival on the same train was entirely coincidental.
entries.zh: 他们搭乘同一班火车到达，完全是巧合。

entries.en: The architect used warm colours and shared gardens to humanize the housing complex.
entries.zh: 建筑师用暖色和共用花园，让这片住宅区更有人情味。

entries.en: The collie waited beside the gate while the sheep crossed the lane.
entries.zh: 羊群穿过小路时，那只柯利牧羊犬在门旁等着。

entries.en: The students chose a coastal landform and explained how waves had shaped it.
entries.zh: 学生们选择了一种海岸地貌，并解释了海浪如何塑造它。

entries.en: Sleet tapped against the windows as we waited for the bus.
entries.zh: 我们等公交车时，雨夹雪敲打着窗户。

entries.en: Her grandmother used lard to make the pastry light and crisp.
entries.zh: 她的祖母用猪油让酥皮变得轻盈松脆。

entries.en: The seminar examined the role of the superego in psychoanalytic theory.
entries.zh: 这堂研讨课研究了超我在精神分析理论中的作用。

entries.meaningZh: 一夫一妻制的；实行单配偶制的
entries.en: The anthropologist compared monogamous marriage with other family structures described in the records.
entries.zh: 这位人类学家把一夫一妻婚姻与记录中描述的其他家庭结构作了比较。

entries.en: Poor connectivity made the video call freeze several times during the meeting.
entries.zh: 网络连通状况不佳，导致会议中的视频通话多次卡住。

entries.en: A local preservationist campaigned to save the old cinema from demolition.
entries.zh: 一位当地保护人士发起活动，争取让老电影院免遭拆除。

entries.en: She sliced a ripe plantain and fried the pieces until golden.
entries.zh: 她把一根熟大蕉切片，煎到金黄。

entries.en: A sudden clang from the kitchen made everyone turn towards the door.
entries.zh: 厨房里突然传来一声金属撞击声，大家都转向门口。

entries.en: The spare chairs were stacked neatly in the storeroom behind the stage.
entries.zh: 备用椅子整齐地堆放在舞台后面的储藏室里。

entries.en: The repair shop found a damaged connector on the computer's motherboard.
entries.zh: 维修店在电脑主板上发现了一个损坏的接头。

entries.en: His authority had remained unquestioned until the younger members demanded a vote.
entries.zh: 他的权威一直未受质疑，直到年轻成员要求投票。

entries.en: A speckled biddy scratched beneath the apple tree while her chicks followed.
entries.zh: 一只斑点母鸡在苹果树下刨土，小鸡们跟在后面。

entries.en: The game was released as shareware, with payment requested after a trial period.
entries.zh: 这款游戏以共享软件形式发布，试用期结束后要求付费。

entries.en: The farmer dressed the scarecrow in an old coat and a floppy hat.
entries.zh: 农民给稻草人穿上一件旧外套，戴上一顶软帽。

entries.en: She was heartbroken when the old family home was destroyed by fire.
entries.zh: 家中的老宅被大火烧毁时，她伤心欲绝。

entries.en: After six days at sea, the sailors made landfall on a small island.
entries.zh: 在海上航行六天后，水手们在一座小岛登陆。

entries.en: Even the team's resident pessimist admitted that the new plan might work.
entries.zh: 就连队里一贯悲观的人也承认，新计划或许能成功。

entries.en: The researchers used genomic data to compare the two populations of fish.
entries.zh: 研究人员用基因组数据比较了这两个鱼类种群。

entries.en: The path dropped precipitously towards the river beyond the last cottage.
entries.zh: 越过最后一间小屋后，小路陡峭地向河边下延。

entries.en: The coach tried to replace the team's negativity with realistic goals.
entries.zh: 教练试图用现实可行的目标改变队伍的消极态度。

entries.en: The guard's alertness helped her notice the open window during her rounds.
entries.zh: 警卫的机敏让她在巡查时注意到了那扇敞开的窗。

entries.en: The museum displayed priestly robes beside objects used in religious ceremonies.
entries.zh: 博物馆在宗教仪式用品旁展出了祭司的长袍。

entries.en: We walked along the moonlit shore until the village lights disappeared behind us.
entries.zh: 我们沿着月光照耀的海岸行走，直到村庄的灯光消失在身后。

entries.en: The history book describes the transfer of power as a bloodless revolution.
entries.zh: 这本历史书把那次权力转移描述为一场不流血的革命。

entries.en: The exhibition includes photographs documenting the hospital's early work in reconstructive surgery.
entries.zh: 展览中有一些照片，记录了这家医院早期开展的重建外科手术工作。

entries.en: She was an unabashed admirer of the band and knew every song.
entries.zh: 她毫不掩饰自己对这支乐队的崇拜，每首歌都很熟悉。

entries.en: The essay explores the feeling of otherness that follows moving to an unfamiliar culture.
entries.zh: 这篇文章探讨了迁居到陌生文化中后产生的异己感。

entries.en: Her latest novella follows three neighbours through a single winter.
entries.zh: 她最新的中篇小说讲述了三个邻居在一个冬天里的经历。

entries.en: From the hilltop gazebo, visitors could see the entire valley below.
entries.zh: 游客从山顶的眺望亭可以看见下方整个山谷。

entries.en: Duplex printing reduced the number of sheets needed for the report.
entries.zh: 双面打印减少了这份报告所需的纸张数量。

entries.en: The riding instructor demonstrated how to sit astride without gripping too tightly.
entries.zh: 骑术教练示范了如何跨坐，同时又不夹得太紧。

entries.en: His suggestion met with derision until the others realized he was serious.
entries.zh: 他的建议遭到了嘲笑，直到其他人意识到他是认真的。

entries.en: The army commandeered the empty school building for use as a temporary headquarters.
entries.zh: 军队征用了那栋空校舍，作为临时指挥部。

entries.en: Rainwater shimmered on the blacktop beneath the supermarket's bright lights.
entries.zh: 超市明亮的灯光下，柏油路面上的雨水闪闪发亮。

entries.en: The tale begins when a fisherman releases a genie from a sealed jar.
entries.zh: 故事一开始，一位渔民从密封的罐子里放出了一个神怪。

entries.en: The guide pointed to the femur in the reconstructed dinosaur skeleton.
entries.zh: 导游指出了复原的恐龙骨架中的股骨。

entries.en: By lunchtime, the fresh snow had turned to grey slush on the pavement.
entries.zh: 到午饭时，新雪已经在人行道上变成了灰色雪泥。

entries.en: The teacher nodded approvingly when the students explained their solution clearly.
entries.zh: 学生们清楚地解释了解题方法，老师赞许地点了点头。

entries.en: The survey asked residents to rate the affordability of housing in their area.
entries.zh: 调查请居民评价所在地区住房的可负担程度。

entries.en: The anthropology lecture discussed circumcision in the context of religious traditions.
entries.zh: 这场人类学讲座在宗教传统的背景下讨论了割礼。

entries.en: A large stoneware crock stood beside the kitchen door, filled with wooden spoons.
entries.zh: 一个大炻器罐放在厨房门旁，里面装满了木勺。

entries.en: The candidate discussed transport funding during a televised senatorial debate.
entries.zh: 候选人在一场电视转播的参议员竞选辩论中讨论了交通资金问题。

entries.en: The slowly turning patterns seemed to hypnotize the audience during the performance.
entries.zh: 演出中，缓缓旋转的图案似乎让观众看得入了迷。

entries.en: A yellowish light from the hallway fell across the dark bedroom floor.
entries.zh: 走廊透来的微黄色灯光洒在昏暗的卧室地板上。

entries.en: He dropped the plate because his hands were wet and soapy.
entries.zh: 他双手湿漉漉的，还沾着肥皂，结果把盘子摔了。

entries.en: Still groggy after the long journey, he leaned on the railing for support.
entries.zh: 长途旅行后他仍然疲软得站不稳，便扶着栏杆支撑身体。

entries.en: His matey manner helped the new volunteers feel welcome at the club.
entries.zh: 他友好随和的态度让新志愿者在俱乐部感到自己受到欢迎。

entries.en: The film turns an ordinary train journey into a nightmarish adventure.
entries.zh: 这部电影把一段普通的火车旅程变成了噩梦般可怕的历险。

entries.en: The seal lifted one flipper as it rolled onto its side.
entries.zh: 那只海豹侧身翻过去时，抬起了一只鳍状肢。

entries.en: In the play, the king orders his guards to behead the prisoner.
entries.zh: 在这出戏里，国王命令卫兵将囚犯斩首。

entries.en: She removed one earphone so she could hear the station announcement.
entries.zh: 她摘下一只耳机，以便听清车站广播。

entries.en: A warm croissant and a cup of coffee arrived on a wooden tray.
entries.zh: 一个热羊角面包和一杯咖啡放在木托盘上端了过来。

entries.en: She folded a clean washcloth and placed it beside the bathroom sink.
entries.zh: 她把一块干净的洗脸巾折好，放在浴室洗手池旁。

entries.en: A small dish of horseradish accompanied the slices of roast beef.
entries.zh: 烤牛肉片旁配了一小碟辣根酱。

entries.en: The gallery paired postmodernist paintings with furniture from the same period.
entries.zh: 画廊把后现代主义绘画与同时期的家具搭配展出。

entries.en: A company bigwig visited the workshop and spoke briefly with the apprentices.
entries.zh: 公司的一位大人物参观了车间，并与学徒们简短交谈。

entries.en: The art class discussed how the painting represents nakedness without idealizing the body.
entries.zh: 美术课讨论了这幅画如何表现裸体，而不将身体理想化。

entries.en: The speaker made a fascinating subject seem uninteresting by reading every slide aloud.
entries.zh: 演讲者逐字念出每张幻灯片，让本来有趣的话题显得乏味。

entries.en: A pearly glow spread across the sky just before sunrise.
entries.zh: 日出前，天空泛起珍珠般的光泽。

entries.en: It was a gutsy decision to perform her own song at the audition.
entries.zh: 在试演时演唱自己创作的歌，是个很有勇气的决定。

entries.en: The legend tells of a seer who warned the village about a coming storm.
entries.zh: 传说讲到一位预言者，他曾警告村民风暴即将来临。

entries.en: The speechwriter revised the opening paragraph to make the speaker's purpose clearer.
entries.zh: 演讲稿撰写人修改了开头一段，使演讲者的目的更加明确。

entries.en: The orchestra played magnificently despite the unexpected change of conductor.
entries.zh: 尽管指挥临时更换，乐团的演奏依然十分出色。

entries.en: The charming scoundrel in the novel deceives nearly everyone he meets.
entries.zh: 小说里那个有魅力的恶棍几乎骗过了他遇到的每一个人。

entries.meaningZh: 技艺高而自负的人（非正式）
entries.en: The young hotshot dismissed the older players' advice and promptly lost the match.
entries.zh: 那位自负的年轻高手不理会老队员的建议，很快就输掉了比赛。

entries.en: The stew tasted good, but some of the meat was tough and stringy.
entries.zh: 炖菜味道不错，不过有些肉又老又多筋。

entries.en: Our small disagreement faded into insignificance when we heard the urgent news.
entries.zh: 听到那条紧急消息后，我们的小分歧就显得无足轻重了。

entries.en: The thoroughness of her research impressed even the most demanding reviewer.
entries.zh: 她研究工作的周密程度，连最苛刻的评审也印象深刻。

entries.en: The project is doable if we divide the work among three people.
entries.zh: 只要把工作分给三个人，这个项目就切实可行。

entries.en: A wooden divider separates the dining area from the busy kitchen.
entries.zh: 一块木质隔板把用餐区与忙碌的厨房分隔开。

entries.en: The awards ceremony opened with a glitzy display of lights and costumes.
entries.zh: 颁奖典礼以璀璨灯光和华丽服装的展示开场。

entries.en: Her teenaged son designed the poster for the neighbourhood concert.
entries.zh: 她十几岁的儿子为邻里音乐会设计了海报。

entries.en: The timetable uses abbreviated station names to fit everything on one page.
entries.zh: 时刻表使用缩写的站名，以便把全部内容排在一页上。

entries.en: He referred obliquely to the disagreement without mentioning anyone by name.
entries.zh: 他间接提到了那次分歧，却没有点任何人的名字。

entries.en: The manager treated temporary staff as expendable when the budget was cut.
entries.zh: 预算削减时，经理把临时员工作为可以舍弃的人。

entries.en: The brevity of her reply suggested that she had little time to talk.
entries.zh: 她简短的回答表明，她没有多少时间交谈。

entries.en: The microbiologist studied bacteria collected from the roots of desert plants.
entries.zh: 这位微生物学家研究了从沙漠植物根部采集的细菌。

entries.en: He watched jealously as his brother unwrapped a much larger present.
entries.zh: 看到哥哥拆开一份大得多的礼物，他嫉妒地望着。

entries.en: The dress has a simple neckline edged with a narrow strip of lace.
entries.zh: 这条连衣裙的领口简洁，边缘饰有一条窄蕾丝。

entries.en: The two sisters looked startlingly alike in the old school photograph.
entries.zh: 在那张旧校园照片里，两姐妹长得惊人地相似。

entries.en: The painter kept a tightly closed bottle of turpentine on the studio shelf.
entries.zh: 画家在画室架子上放了一瓶盖紧的松节油。

entries.en: The children clapped rhythmically while the drummer played a simple pattern.
entries.zh: 鼓手敲着简单的节拍，孩子们有节奏地拍手。

entries.en: We had to disassemble the table before carrying it through the narrow doorway.
entries.zh: 我们得先把桌子拆开，才能搬过那道窄门。

entries.en: She tacitly acknowledged his help with a grateful smile.
entries.zh: 她报以感激的微笑，默默地表示对他帮助的认可。

entries.en: Despite his protestations, the organisers moved his stall to the back of the hall.
entries.zh: 尽管他一再抗议，组织者还是把他的摊位移到了大厅后方。

entries.en: In the thriller, a hired goon follows the journalist through the city.
entries.zh: 在这部惊悚小说中，一名受雇暴徒一路跟踪记者穿过城市。

entries.en: The museum exhibit explores the use of divination in ancient societies.
entries.zh: 这个博物馆展览探讨了古代社会中占卜的使用。

entries.en: A mossy stone wall marked the boundary of the abandoned orchard.
entries.zh: 一堵长满苔藓的石墙标示着那座废弃果园的边界。

entries.en: She ran her hand over the wood to check its smoothness.
entries.zh: 她用手摸过木头表面，检查是否光滑。

entries.en: The restaurant was romantically lit with candles on every table.
entries.zh: 餐厅里每张桌上都点着蜡烛，灯光十分浪漫。

entries.en: The children made a secret hideout behind the garden shed.
entries.zh: 孩子们在花园小屋后面建了一个秘密藏身处。

entries.en: Moving the fallen tree alone would have required superhuman strength.
entries.zh: 独自搬走那棵倒下的树，需要超人的力量。

entries.en: The hologram seemed to float above the display as we walked around it.
entries.zh: 我们绕着展台走动时，那幅全息图仿佛悬浮在展台上方。

entries.en: I unknowingly took someone else's umbrella when I left the café.
entries.zh: 离开咖啡馆时，我无意中拿走了别人的伞。

entries.en: The course compares accounts of creationism in several religious traditions.
entries.zh: 这门课比较了几种宗教传统中对神创论的表述。

entries.en: Passengers waited for the gangway to be secured before they could disembark.
entries.zh: 乘客们等舷梯固定好后，才可以离船上岸。

entries.en: The solidity of the old oak table surprised everyone who tried to move it.
entries.zh: 凡是试着搬过那张旧橡木桌的人，都惊讶于它的坚实。

entries.en: A clearly marked cabinet near reception contains the building's defibrillator.
entries.zh: 接待处附近一个标识清楚的柜子里放着楼内的除颤器。

entries.en: The inscription on the gravestone had become difficult to read after many winters.
entries.zh: 经历多年寒冬后，墓碑上的铭文已经难以辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 为取得优势而采用的开局棋法
entries.en: The chess player tried an unusual gambit to surprise her experienced opponent.
entries.zh: 这位棋手尝试了一种不寻常的开局弃子策略，希望让经验丰富的对手措手不及。

entries.en: The medical textbook separates degenerative conditions from injuries caused by accidents.
entries.zh: 这本医学教材将退行性病变与事故造成的损伤分开讲述。

entries.en: They spoke in an undertone so they would not wake the sleeping baby.
entries.zh: 他们低声说话，以免吵醒熟睡的婴儿。

entries.en: He found a matching door for the old car at a junkyard.
entries.zh: 他在废品场找到了一个与那辆旧车配套的车门。

entries.en: A tiny fern grew from a cranny in the stone wall.
entries.zh: 一株小蕨类植物从石墙的一道细缝里长了出来。

entries.en: The judges found the design practical but unimaginative, with nothing to distinguish it.
entries.zh: 评委认为这个设计实用却缺乏想象力，没有什么独特之处。

entries.en: She assiduously checked every reference before sending the manuscript to the publisher.
entries.zh: 她勤勉地核查了每一条参考文献，然后才把书稿寄给出版商。

entries.en: The prince regarded the throne as his birthright and refused to share power.
entries.zh: 王子把王位视为自己与生俱来的权利，拒绝分享权力。

entries.en: A phalanx of photographers waited outside the theatre for the arriving actors.
entries.zh: 一大群摄影记者密集地等在剧院外，等候演员到来。

entries.en: She subconsciously copied her teacher's gestures while explaining the exercise.
entries.zh: 解释这道练习时，她在潜意识里模仿了老师的手势。

entries.en: The monument depicts a liberator welcoming prisoners as they leave the gates.
entries.zh: 纪念碑刻画了一位解放者迎接囚犯走出大门的情景。

entries.en: The pacemaker led the runners through the first few laps at a steady speed.
entries.zh: 领跑员以稳定的速度带领选手跑过了最初几圈。

entries.en: The fantasy story centres on an unholy alliance between two rival sorcerers.
entries.zh: 这个奇幻故事围绕两个敌对巫师结成的邪恶联盟展开。

entries.en: Opening the windows made the heat in the crowded room more bearable.
entries.zh: 打开窗户后，拥挤房间里的炎热变得更能忍受了。

entries.en: The museum's old stock ticker still had a strip of paper curling from it.
entries.zh: 博物馆里那台旧股票行情收录器上，仍有一条纸带卷曲着伸出来。

entries.en: He pulled a fistful of coins from his coat pocket.
entries.zh: 他从外套口袋里掏出一把硬币。

entries.en: The guidebook recommends the riverside district for its lively nightlife.
entries.zh: 旅行指南因河畔区热闹的夜生活而推荐那里。

entries.en: The charity operates regionally, with small offices in six nearby towns.
entries.zh: 这家慈善机构在本地区开展业务，在附近六个城镇设有小型办事处。

entries.en: A moment of inattention caused him to miss the turn to the campsite.
entries.zh: 一时疏忽让他错过了通往营地的转弯处。

entries.en: The school survey asked how the new timetable affected students' wellbeing.
entries.zh: 学校的调查询问了新作息时间表如何影响学生的身心健康。

entries.en: She humbly thanked the volunteers and credited them with the event's success.
entries.zh: 她谦逊地感谢了志愿者，并把活动的成功归功于他们。

entries.en: He wilfully ignored the instructions and painted over the warning label.
entries.zh: 他故意无视说明，用油漆盖住了警告标签。

entries.en: A dark monolith rose from the plain, visible long before we reached the ruins.
entries.zh: 一块深色巨石矗立在平原上，我们还远未到达遗址就看见了它。

entries.en: She used a soft duster to clean the narrow gaps between the shelves.
entries.zh: 她用一把柔软的掸子清理架子之间的窄缝。

entries.en: The report describes the attempted extermination of an invasive insect on the island.
entries.zh: 这份报告描述了彻底清除岛上一种入侵昆虫的尝试。
